parameters.content:
## Setup Notes - FULLY FREE, ONE PROVIDER (OpenRouter)
- RSS feeds pre-filled with two verified working software-house feeds (YesITLabs, Flexsin) - swap for your real competitors.
- Point your social listening / press-release tool at the webhook URL from 'Social Media & Press Release Webhook'.
- ALL AI work (chat analysis + embeddings) now runs through ONE OpenRouter credential. Create a Header Auth credential 'OpenRouter API Key': header 'Authorization' = 'Bearer sk-or-...', select it in 'AI - Analyze and Classify Update' AND 'Generate Embedding - OpenRouter (bge-m3)'.
- Chat model: 'openrouter/free' (auto-router, always live, structured-JSON capable).
- Embedding model: BAAI/bge-m3 via OpenRouter's /embeddings endpoint - NOT $0, costs ~$0.01 per 1M input tokens (fractions of a cent per run), needs a small funded OpenRouter balance. Genuinely free alternative was Google Gemini if you change your mind later.
- CRITICAL: bge-m3 outputs 1024-dimension vectors. Recreate your Pinecone index with Dimensions = 1024.
- Set your own Pinecone index host in both HTTP Request nodes ('Query Similar Past Insights' and 'Store Insight') - replace the YOUR-PINECONE-INDEX-HOST placeholder with your real index URL from the Pinecone console.

## Retry Pattern (FIXED)
All 5 retry chains (Scrape, AI, Pinecone Store, Slack category, Slack escalation) now read their retry count back from the Increment node's OWN prior output (with a safe try/catch fallback to 0 on first attempt) instead of trusting the failing node's error-branch output to carry the count forward - the latter does not reliably happen in n8n and was causing infinite retry loops.

The embedding is generated ONCE and reused twice: first to query Pinecone for historical context, then again at storage time.

'Log Storage Outcome', 'Log Category Slack Outcome', and 'Log Final Status' also re-fetch original data across the error boundary - do not remove, downstream nodes depend on them.

## Test Before Activating
1. Run 'Execute previous nodes' from AI - Analyze and Classify Update with a real competitor URL to confirm the full chain end-to-end.
2. Sample webhook payload:
{ "competitor_name": "Acme Corp", "title": "Acme launches new pricing tier", "link": "https://acme.com/news/pricing", "content": "..." }
3. Expected Slack message: emoji + impact level, category, summary, strategic recommendation, source link.
4. To test the retry/backoff path, temporarily point the scrape URL at an invalid domain and confirm 3 retry-attempt log lines + 1 exhaustion log line appear before fallback kicks in - it should now stop at 3, not loop forever.
